'''Zurel Hoban''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Zurel Hoban was raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], and was the son of an aide to the world's [[Senator/Legends|senator]]. Hoban applied to join the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], using his father's contacts to ensure that his application was accepted. He was eventually assigned to serve aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], where he worked on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] crewmember. Following the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanith Sorn]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Hoban was part of a team chosen by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to investigate the crime.
